purpose: Descriptive topology features and redundancy controls; no trading overlay, return prediction or candidate selection
calendar: All observed development and validation sessions, 2010-01-04 through 2019-12-31; require every declared window on every date
points: 24 assets; each represented by its demeaned unit-length trailing simple-return vector. SPY is only a volatility control.
distance: Complete Pearson correlation distance sqrt(2*(1-rho)); include negative correlations; no trading-graph threshold or sparsification
filtration: Vietoris-Rips with edge threshold epsilon (not ball radius); full filtration; homology dimensions 0 and 1; coefficients F2

features.h1_max: Maximum finite H1 length, zero for empty H1

infinite_bars: Exclude exactly one essential infinite H0 interval; require no infinite H1 interval. Preserve the essential count separately; never replace infinity by an arbitrary cap.
zero_bars: Retain every positive lifetime output by the engine without a fitted persistence threshold; count omitted zero H0 merges if duplicate points occur
control_window: Same trailing window as each topology feature; annualisation sqrt(252)
comparisons: Within-phase Spearman correlations for all 4 features x 3 controls x 3 windows; no p-values. Descriptive OLS with intercept and three controls, centred/scaled only on development, fitted only on development, evaluated in both phases for all windows. No target portfolio returns.
r2: 1-SSE/sum((feature-phase_mean)^2); validation phase mean used only to score, not fit. Negative values retained.
window_stability: Paired-date within-phase Spearman correlation of each alternate-window feature with the primary; all results retained.
diagram_checks: On final observed session of each calendar month: compare 63/252 with 126 using bottleneck distance for finite H0/H1; verify d_B <= max_abs(D_alt-D_primary)+2e-6. This is a numerical bound check, not evidence of window invariance.
visualisation: 120 monthly primary-window H1 persistence diagrams and first five landscape layers over a fixed 0..2 grid. Layer rank is discrete; interpolation is visual only. Visualisation does not enter feature extraction.
causality: Feature dated t consumes data through t only; any future overlay must shift to t+1 execution with first return t+2, following the existing ledger.
known_information: Baseline and graph development/validation returns already known before this protocol. No historical topology feature outputs examined before lock. Local record, not external preregistration.
holdout: Do not download, calculate topology for or evaluate 2020-2025.
non_goals: No economic benefit inferred from low redundancy
No selection of best window or feature after results
